title: Machine Translation Meta Evaluation through Translation Accuracy Challenge Sets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation metrics using contrastive challenge sets based on the WinoMT dataset, comparing how metrics score ambiguous occupation names that are disambiguated with 'female' versus 'male' cues to detect systematic gender preferences.

Comparing metric scores on word-sense disambiguation challenge sets (derived from the MuCoW dataset) to determine if machine translation evaluation metrics systematically prefer translations with frequent senses over infrequent ones.
